notes.title: New Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

It's been some time, but [i]Lifestream[/i] has received a new update.  The changes are both cosmetic, featuring a new graphic style that fits the look of our latest game, [i]Stonewall Penitentiary[/i], and functional, consisting of engine optimization and bug fixes.  A full list of changes is below.

Changes in the latest update:

- Updated graphics to fit new comic style of [i]Stonewall Penitentiary[/i]
- Removed unnecessary difficulty levels
- Added Shady Brook preview and codex link to Extras section of main menu
- Added text resizing options on the PC, along with scrolling
- Improved inventory handling
- Added compass direction labels on the PC
- Optimized engine
- Small gameplay-related bug fixes and grammatical errors

In addition, we've created a new Steam group!  Join the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/storycentric]Storycentric Worlds[/url] community today to stay up-to-date on our latest projects.

Regards,
The Unimatrix Productions Team

notes.title: Important Update - Screen Resolution & Aspect Ratio
notes.content:
We released an important update today that greatly improves the screen resolution and aspect ratio compatibility of Lifestream.

If you were previously having issues with this, they should now be resolved!

Thanks in advance for your patience.  Happy adventuring!

notes.title: Small Lifestream Update Released to Fix Bug
notes.content:
A user has reported running into an issue where the text is too large to fit within the game window, resulting in an inability to read the story. If you encounter this issue, please know that I have implemented a temporary fix.

To resize the text during a cutscene or in the game, simply use the page up/page down keys. The game will remember your settings, so you should only have to do this once.

After I track down and fix the bug, I will implement a more permanent fix.

I apologize for any inconvenience this may cause! If you run into any issues with this or any other aspect of the game, please do not hesitate to let me know.

Have fun, everyone!
